name: Your Company
tagline: A retro coffee house on Afrosiyob: filter coffee, syrniki and seventies music
niche: Coffee house with breakfasts and pastries

listing.description: A site for a seventies-style breakfast café: a rainbow of warm stripes, steam over the mug, a menu board with prices and a cup that fills as you scroll.

seo.title: Your Company — retro coffee house with breakfasts in Tashkent
seo.description: Filter coffee, espresso and breakfast until 3 pm at 12 Afrosiyob St. Syrniki, granola, croissants from our own bakery. Mon–Fri 8:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 9:00–23:00.
seo.answer: Your Company is a coffee house at 12 Afrosiyob St in the Mirabad district of Tashkent. Breakfast is served until 3 pm: syrniki — 42,000 UZS, granola — 38,000 UZS; filter coffee from 24,000 UZS, cappuccino — 28,000 UZS. Open 8:00–22:00 on weekdays and 9:00–23:00 at weekends.

sections.title: Mornings start with a drop
sections.subtitle: Pour-over filter coffee, syrniki fried in ghee and records spinning from morning till night. Breakfast until three in the afternoon, Saturdays included.

sections.label: The café
sections.title: We opened a place where nobody has to rush
sections.text: The room has twenty-eight seats, a record player, a shelf of vinyl and a window onto the old plane trees of Afrosiyob. In the morning people have breakfast before work, in the afternoon they work on laptops, in the evening they come for dessert. Our beans are roasted for us once a week, and we bake the croissants ourselves from six in the morning.

items.name: Croissant
items.text: Baked from six in the morning

items.title: Grind
items.text: We grind right before brewing — medium, like sea salt.

items.title: Bloom
items.text: For the first 30 seconds the coffee breathes out its gas.

items.title: Pour
items.text: We pour 93 °C water in a thin spiral stream, three times.

items.title: Cup
items.text: Four minutes later — 250 ml of clean coffee with no bitterness.

items.quote: Syrniki just like grandma’s, and the filter is better than in plenty of places downtown.
items.author: Nigora

items.quote: I work here with my laptop: sockets at every table and nobody hurries you.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: We had the halva raf and carrot cake — and had to come back the next day.
items.author: Alina and Said

items.a: Every day until 3 pm, weekends included.

items.q: Can I take coffee to go?
items.a: Yes, any drink comes in a cup with a lid. Leave an order on the site and pick it up without queuing.
Oat and almond, +6,000 UZS per drink.

items.q: Can I buy beans to take home?
items.a: Yes, 250 g bags from 110,000 UZS. We’ll grind them for your brewer.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Come for breakfast
sections.text: 12 Afrosiyob — a five-minute walk from Kosmonavtlar metro. Parking in the courtyard.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Coffee for home
sections.text: Add to cart and check out — we will call to confirm and deliver.

items.text: Jasmine, bergamot, lemon zest. Light roast.

items.name: Brazil Cerrado

items.name: House espresso blend

items.name: Decaf Colombia
